item.title: 中国“九章四号”问世，光量子优越性实现大规模扩展
item.description: 中国科学技术大学潘建伟、陆朝阳团队研制的新一代光量子计算原型机“九章四号”5月13日在《自然》杂志发表。该机包含8176个光学模式，较2023年发布的“九章三号”扩大逾50倍。研究团队估算，若用目前全球最快的超级计算机El Capitan模拟其在25微秒内的输出，需耗时逾10^42年，超出当前估算宇宙年龄32个数量级。

item.title: Quantum simulation of real-time bosonic dynamics with binary and unary position encodings on superconducting and trapped-ion processors
item.description: arXiv:2611.13079v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulating a bosonic degree of freedom on qubit hardware requires discretizing its position space, and the qubit encoding of the resulting lattice determines the circuits that realize its real-time dynamics. item.title: Optical experiment demonstrates the strong Mpemba effect in a single qubit
item.description: Typically, after a physical system is disturbed, it can gradually return toward a state of thermal equilibrium by exchanging heat with its surroundings. Thermal equilibrium is a state in which there is no net transfer of heat between the system and its surroundings.
